name: chip-design-mcp
description: MCP server and React webapp for open-source chip design: write hardware in Verilog, run simulation and synthesis, optional place-and-route to GDSII layout files. Yosys, sky130 PDK, OpenLane (Docker). MCP/REST :11022, dashboard :11023.
long_description: Chip Design MCP connects AI agents and humans to real FOSS EDA tools—not a toy demo. Use natural language or MCP tools to scaffold projects, run Yosys synthesis on Verilog (RTL = register-transfer level, the usual way digital chips are described), simulate with cocotb and Icarus Verilog, and optionally run OpenLane in Docker to produce GDSII (the standard file format fabs use for chip geometry). Includes ChipLab guided workflows, a React dashboard with Help docs, Prefab status cards, and honest reporting when binaries or PDKs are missing. Windows launcher can bootstrap Docker, WSL tools, and volare sky130.
